description: Spec-Driven Development traceability registry. Each requirement links a PsyUML spec section (the source of truth) to a roadmap milestone and the implementation/test paths that will satisfy it. Validated by sdd/check.mjs. Statuses: planned | in-progress | implemented | deprecated. Impl/test paths are existence-checked only once a requirement leaves 'planned'.

requirements.title: 8-category core ontology + metamodel (OT/RT/PT)
requirements.notes: Nodes (8 element categories), typed connectors, and the property bag. Stereotypes per §K.

requirements.title: Concrete notation: glyphs + connectors render to SVG
requirements.notes: Native SVG authoritative; Mermaid is approximate export only.

requirements.title: GUI editor: palette, properties panel, save/load, export
UX research → per-persona user stories + cross-cutting requirements
requirements.notes: Deep-research synthesis (5 angles, primary-source-verified): 5 personas (therapist/client/solo/researcher/ritual), MoSCoW requirements (accessibility WCAG 2.2, plain-language client layer, colour-redundant, crisis-for-constriction, local-first privacy, co-authorship, emotional safety, no-diagnosis), risks/anti-requirements, and the usability-test open questions feeding REQ-EVAL-SUITE. Requirements authored; editor implementation lands in M2.

requirements.title: Collaborative co-authorship + client ownership of the formulation
requirements.notes: UX-M6 / P1.1 / P2.2: shared/concurrent editing, free-text + verbatim labels, visible authorship, client can relabel/hide/correct, reversible. Collaboration is the evidence-supported active ingredient (Thrower 2024; BPS 2011). M2: in-place label editing per layer (node panel); real-time concurrent editing is later.

requirements.title: Emotional-safety UX: progressive reveal, save-incomplete, non-pathologizing defaults
requirements.notes: UX-M7 / P1.3 / P2.3: a poorly-handled formulation can distress (Redhead 2015) — progressive reveal, never force completion, soft wording, opt-in trauma detail, no unprompted 'verdict' diagram. M2: per-node hide/show (progressive reveal) via the node panel + standing disclaimer + save-incomplete (nothing auto-finalized) shipped.

requirements.title: Decision/Navigation (crisis) chart, client-usable
requirements.notes: UX-M4 (crisis-for-cognitive-constriction): one decision/step, escalation ladder, localized crisis resources on every screen, means-restriction step, no dead-ends, human escalation, large text (Stanley 2018; Morrison 2024). No AI handles crises. M2: renderDecisionChart + always-visible crisis banner + decision-nav example shipped; the no-dead-ends / crisis-resource-present lint lands in M3 (REQ-SAFETY-TRIAGE).

requirements.title: Resource/Anchor map
requirements.notes: M2: renderResourceMap (categorized anchors under People/Skills/Values/Soothing, CFT footer) + resource-anchor example shipped and wired into the editor.

requirements.title: Process/Loop diagram type (maintaining cycles)
requirements.notes: renderLoopMap (ring layout, reciprocal double-headed links, reinforcing/balancing centre badge, dashed exits) + process-loop example, wired into the editor; path-of-hope validation applies (a loop must show a way out).

requirements.title: Abstract-syntax well-formedness rules enforced
requirements.notes: Enforced: single-source/target edges + live endpoints (r2), band refs resolve (r1), relations join people/parts/contexts not states/resources (r3), interventions never float unattached (r4), dissociative barriers separate only parts/states (r6), client-facing disclaimer + crisis-resource gate (r7). r5 loop typing is structural (loop marker is the R/B enum); full closed-path/exit detection tracked with the diff/loop work.

requirements.title: No meaning by color alone; monochrome-printable; min text size; alt-text + text summary per view
requirements.notes: Every rendered view also emits a plain-language text summary + alt text (Source 3 C8, WCAG 2.2). The editor itself meets WCAG 2.2 AA — keyboard operation, contrast, 200% zoom, target size, colour-redundant (UX-M1, docs/ux). M3: validate flags over-long labels (a11y.label-length); the examples corpus is lint-gated in CI.

requirements.title: Path-of-hope clinical-safety lint (no hopeless-only diagrams)
requirements.notes: Generalizes §A.2-r5 to every diagram; hard-block in the client layer. Companion-paper idea A4. M3: implemented in @psyuml/validate (warn for clinician, error for client) + surfaced in the editor's formulation-health panel, gating export.

requirements.title: Disclaimer + crisis fields gating; non-pathologizing client layer
requirements.notes: M3: client-facing diagrams require a standing disclaimer (error if missing); the editor gates export on a clean validation report. Standing non-diagnosis disclaimer shown in the editor.

requirements.title: School profiles + polymorphic re-render + translation table
requirements.notes: One immutable model, many views. Provenance tags preserve opposed origin-claims (§G.2 caveat). M4: @psyuml/profiles ships the §G.2 translation table (TRANSLATIONS) + translate() + roleLabelsFor(); the renderer takes a roleLabels map and the editor has a School switcher (IFS/schema/structural-dissociation/TA) that re-labels the Parts Map vocabulary while keeping structure + provenance. Full per-diagram profiles (glyph/layout/validators) + more families (loops/beliefs) still to come.

requirements.title: Relational Field / genogram (McGoldrick–Gerson–Petry set) — diagram type §E.3
requirements.notes: renderRelationalField: manual node positions; gender glyphs (male square / female circle / other diamond / system dashed); index double-border; McGoldrick relation line styles (close solid, distant dashed, conflict zigzag, fused triple, cutoff slashed) + nestedWithin origin thread (fine-dotted + ring) + ecomap. Subsumes the drama triangle (§E.3) — see drama-triangle.psyuml under REQ-RESEARCH-PROFILES. Completes the 9-type diagram catalog. Cross-school re-render/translation table still under REQ-CROSS-SCHOOL.

requirements.title: Schema Mode Map, CAT SDR, Malan Two Triangles, Karpman nested triangles
requirements.notes: Companion-paper profiles; each per §K extension rules (idea-incorporation §2). M5: Schema Mode Map shipped (renderModeMap — circle size = dominance with redundant numeral, §D; Healthy-Adult growth target; vulnerable-child wound marker). Karpman drama triangle shipped as a Relational Field instance (spec §E.3): drama-triangle.psyuml places Persecutor/Rescuer/Victim with a NESTED historical triangle wired via the nestedWithin connector (drawn by relLine as a fine-dotted origin thread with a ring). Malan Two Triangles shipped as the two-triangles diagram type (renderTwoTriangles): the Triangle of Conflict (Defence/Anxiety/Hidden feeling) + Triangle of Person (Current/Transference/Past) as band-grouped triads linked by the transference connector (dotted) — closing the last dangling edge kind. Both nestedWithin and transference are now used. CAT SDR shipped as a process-loop instance (cat-sdr.psyuml): the reciprocal role (criticizing ⇄ criticized) via the reciprocal double-arrow, the trap procedure as edge labels, marked exits, and the CAT observing-eye glyph (renderLoopMap now draws an eye for stereotype 'observing-eye'). All four named M5 research profiles (Schema Mode Map, Karpman, Malan, CAT SDR) are shipped; the §K mechanism stays open for further profiles.

requirements.title: Model versioning + diff view (longitudinal progress)
requirements.notes: Companion-paper idea A6. Versions documents, not the person. M6: @psyuml/diff ships diffModels() — matches nodes/edges by stable id (§H.10) so a rename reads as a label change, surfaces the spec's progress deltas (dominance up/down, forming/liminal->consolidated 'dashed->solid', valence, add/remove/rename) — plus summarizeDiff() readable lines and isEmptyDiff(). render.renderDiff() draws an accessible monochrome 'progress card' (↑/↓ glyphs + a dashed->solid swatch, §D); the editor has a 'Compare with...' file load showing the changes-since panel + an Export-progress-SVG button. Still to come: an immutable per-session version store and Timeline/Trajectory (§E.5) wiring.

requirements.title: Timeline/Trajectory diagram type
requirements.notes: renderTimeline: bands = time columns, stereotype action/identity = the two narrative landscapes, with a problem-saturated -> preferred-future baseline + trajectory arrows. timeline example wired into the editor.

requirements.title: Intervention Sequence diagram type
requirements.notes: renderInterventionSeq: actor swimlanes (bands) as columns, interventions as hexagons placed by longest-path phase order, guards as edge labels; example wired into the editor. The grief-ritual interop node (§F.6) lands with the Ritual diagram (M7).

requirements.title: Ritual modality first-class, secular variant + honest framing required
requirements.notes: renderRitual (van Gennep phase columns, LIMINAL dashed, ritual-act hexagons, mandatory framing+secular footer); model.meta.ritual carries framing/secularVariant; validate errors if either is missing (ethics.ritual-framing / ethics.ritual-secular), so the editor blocks ritual export without them. §F.6 interop (same hexagon as an Intervention-Sequence node) follows.

requirements.title: Bounded narrative→draft-model assist (human-in-the-loop, formulation-only)
requirements.notes: No diagnosis/severity scoring; no safeguard-bypass. M8: @psyuml/ai ships assist(narrative,{model,consented,terms},extractor?) — the GUARDRAILS of the Source-3 pipeline, enforced + tested with no live model call: consent gate (no consent -> nothing processed); PII minimization via @psyuml/privacy.redactText BEFORE the extractor sees the text; safety triage that HALTS and escalates before extraction (when requiresHumanEscalation(model) or a coarse acute-risk/psychosis marker trips); every suggestion wrapped low-confidence (confidence 'L', epistemicStatus 'inferred'); nothing auto-applied (applySuggestions is a separate explicit accept step). The narrative->suggestions step is a pluggable Extractor (default noopExtractor) so a model-agnostic LLM extractor drops in without changing the safety envelope, and the package is isolated (removing it leaves the editor working). Still to come: an actual LLM-backed extractor + an editor AI panel + an audit log. Out of scope (kept out): diagnosis/severity, safeguard-bypass, autonomous formulation, live-care advice (idea-incorporation §3–5).

requirements.title: Text DSL ⇄ model round-trip + CLI
requirements.notes: M9: @psyuml/grammar ships toDSL()/fromDSL() — a line-oriented text surface (diagram/lang/title/disclaimer/crisis/ritual/flag headers; band/node/edge statements; double-quoted free text with \" + \\ escapes; omit-on-default + a labeljson escape for multi-language labels). Lossless round-trip is proven over the whole corpus (fromDSL(toDSL(parseModel(x))) deep-equals parseModel(x)) since both sides are parseModel-normalized; the editor has a Text (DSL) view/edit panel. @psyuml/cli ships `psyuml lint|render|convert` as a pure run(argv,io) (unit-tested with a fake IO) bundled to a runnable dist/cli/psyuml.mjs by scripts/build-cli.mjs (esbuild, already in the toolchain): lint validates JSON-or-DSL input (auto-detected) and exits non-zero on any error-severity issue — a CI/pre-commit gate mirroring the editor's export gate. Still to come: a FHIR/SNOMED `export` subcommand (REQ-INTEROP-FHIR) and non-programmer-friendly parse error messages (idea-incorporation §7).

requirements.title: Conformance suite + semver release flow (v1.0 readiness)
requirements.notes: Leaving v0.x stays gated on the spec's Stage-4 clinical evidence. Conformance includes the round-trip invariant (Source 3). M10: conformance/ suite runs per-example round-trip + validation (both layers) + accessible-SVG (role/aria/alt) + monochrome + type coverage, in CI.

requirements.title: Epistemic status on every node/edge (reported/observed/inferred/planned/symbolic)
requirements.notes: Source 3 C2. Formulation as working hypothesis. Rendered via a redundant, collision-checked line-style + tag; never system-confirmed for ritual/spiritual claims.

requirements.title: Multilingual model: stable concept IDs separate from localized labels (BCP 47, Unicode)
requirements.notes: Source 3 C7. label = { BCP-47 -> text } over a stable id; clinician/client variants per language.

requirements.title: Clinical-hazard lint + risk/psychosis safety gate
requirements.notes: Source 3 C3. Acute-risk/psychosis -> block autonomous formulation + human-review banner; risky-ritual materials -> documentation-only; typed-edge requirement; mixed-school provenance; PII redact-by-default. Gates the AI-assist pipeline. M3: crisis no-dead-ends + crisis-resources lint shipped; acute-risk + psychosis triage now act on meta.safety (escalation warning, acute-risk-requires-crisis-resources error, ritual-under-psychosis contraindication) + a mixed-school provenance notice; validate exports requiresHumanEscalation() which the editor reads to raise a clinical-escalation banner and which AI-assist (M8) reads to halt. Typed edges are enforced at parse time (EdgeKind required). PII redact-by-default still lands with privacy/AI (M8).

requirements.title: Body Map view (somatic: body-located sensations, arousal curve, sensory channels)
requirements.notes: Source 3 C4. renderBodyMap: body silhouette + sensations placed by position, sized by intensity (redundant numeral, §D), with a pacing/titration safety note. body-map example wired into the editor. Arousal-curve / sensory-channel overlays can follow.

requirements.title: Privacy-by-default: de-identification, role-scoped export, redaction, audit log, consent
requirements.notes: Source 3 C10 (HIPAA/GDPR-informed). Local-first; no PHI leaves device without role-specific consent; conservative human-supervised-formulation posture, not live-care CDS. M8: @psyuml/privacy ships deidentify(model,{terms}) — scrubs node/edge/band/trigger labels + title (emails, links, phone-like runs, caller-supplied name terms) and reports each redaction, while preserving the public-safe disclaimer + crisis line; never mutates input. Exposed as `psyuml redact` (writes de-identified JSON, prints the count to stderr). This is the PII-minimization step for AI-assist (M8) and the basis for a de-identified interop export (M9). Still to come: role-scoped export + an audit log, and consent gating in the AI pipeline.

requirements.title: FHIR/SNOMED + de-identified research export
requirements.notes: Source 3 C6. Observation, QuestionnaireResponse, CarePlan, Goal, Patient/RelatedPerson; SNOMED where apt; de-identified by default; export-only, regulation-sensitive (late + optional).

requirements.title: Evaluation suite (comprehension, collaborative validity, editability, fidelity, safety, privacy, interop, accessibility)
requirements.notes: Source 3 C11. Operationalizes the §J rubric + Stage-4 gate.

requirements.title: Notation style guide + clinician/client cheat-sheets
requirements.notes: Alt-plan cross-check (idea-incorporation §7): color semantics, line weights, emotional-valence + epistemic-status encoding, ritual cultural-sensitivity notes; quick-reference cheat sheets.

requirements.title: Printable blank session templates
requirements.notes: Alt-plan cross-check: hand-drawable blank templates per diagram type for paper use in session.

requirements.title: Multi-school worked-case corpus
requirements.notes: Alt-plan cross-check: case studies beyond the composite 'R.' (CBT panic, IFS, family genogram, grief-ritual, ...), each as .psyuml + golden.

requirements.title: Practitioner handbook / tutorial
requirements.notes: Alt-plan cross-check: per-diagram how-tos, co-creating-in-session guidance, exercises, self-guided reflection; ethical guidance against pseudo-clinical overreach.

requirements.title: Adoption pack (workshops, extension guide, comprehension instruments)
requirements.notes: Alt-plan cross-check: workshop decks + facilitator scripts; a notation-extension contributor guide (clinicians proposing symbols); comprehension-test instruments + pilot-study design. Extends REQ-EVAL-SUITE.
